mapper.select: SELECT revision,stop_reason FROM catalog_shard_control WHERE shard_id=#{shard}
SELECT FROM catalog_outbox WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND purpose='KAFKA' AND outbox_id>#{after} ORDER BY outbox_id LIMIT 10
SELECT FROM catalog_step WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND step_key>#{after} ORDER BY step_key LIMIT 10
SELECT catalog_receipt_valid(#{step}) FROM catalog_shard_control WHERE shard_id=#{shard}
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_shard_control SET stop_reason=NULL,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE shard_id=#{shard} AND revision=#{revision} AND stop_reason=#{reason} AND mode='ACTIVE' AND initialization_ready=true
